package.name: autoware_vehicle_bridge
package.description: Autoware Universe ROS 2 to CAN bridge for the E-Trike (Jetson Orin). Converts Control commands to CAN frames (0x300, 0x301, 0x302, 0x7FC) on the high-level CAN bus and decodes feedback frames (0x120, 0x011, 0x210, 0x600, 0x7FD) into ROS 2 vehicle reports. Implements inverse tricycle kinematics, heartbeat liveness monitoring, and command timeout safety.
